definitions.gloss: real name, true name, birth name
definitions.explanation: A person's actual legal name, as opposed to a stage name, pen name, nickname, or pseudonym.

examples.japanese: あの{芸能人|げいのうじん}の{本名|ほんみょう}は{知|し}られていない。
examples.english: That celebrity's real name is not known.

examples.japanese: {芸名|げいめい}ではなく{本名|ほんみょう}で{活動|かつどう}している。
examples.english: She performs under her real name, not a stage name.

examples.japanese: インターネット{上|じょう}では{本名|ほんみょう}を{使|つか}わない{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people don't use their real names on the internet.

notes:
{本名|ほんみょう} is a person's actual legal name, as opposed to any kind of alias, stage name, or pseudonym.

PRONUNCIATION:
Also sometimes read as ほんめい, though ほんみょう is the standard modern reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本名|ほんみょう}を{明|あ}かす: to reveal one's real name
- {本名|ほんみょう}で{活動|かつどう}する: to work under one's real name
- {本名|ほんみょう}{非公開|ひこうかい}: real name not disclosed
- {本名|ほんみょう}を{隠|かく}す: to hide one's real name

CONTRASTS WITH OTHER NAME TYPES:
- {芸名|げいめい}: stage name (entertainers)
- {筆名|ひつめい} / ペンネーム: pen name (writers)
- {偽名|ぎめい}: false name, alias
- ハンドルネーム: online handle/username
- {通称|つうしょう}: commonly used name, nickname
- {旧姓|きゅうせい}: maiden name, former surname

USAGE:
With the rise of the internet and social media, the concept of {本名|ほんみょう} vs. online identity has become an important topic in Japan. {本名|ほんみょう}{登録|とうろく} (real-name registration) is required on some platforms.
